extraction.Name: James Bowman
extraction.Recorded patent: Yes, filed for record in Pawnee County, Okla.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Land sold for $7000 and two lots and small house in Yale, Okla.
extraction.Occupation/Income: Gets annuity paid to Pawnee tribe; income per annum from inherited land
extraction.NOTES: Date and manner of delivery of patent March 5, 1918; patent receipted for yes; $8000.00 received which was a good price at that time; sale described as settlement of an old debt; fair health, no property or money accumulated; only wife dependent upon him; evidence of fraud does not appear in this case; notarized Nov. 26, 1928, Pawnee County, Oklahoma; commission expires Jan. 31, 1929; allottee number also referenced as 61391
